content.text:
I submitted an equal-weight portfolio of 235 reversed trend signals: tsmom with 63, 126 and 252-day lookbacks, plus the 21/63 and 50/200 moving-average crossovers, across all industries. Its training Sharpe is about 0.49, and it did not pass the 2000–2012 validation (FAIL).

It rests on one observation: trend-following on industry-minus-market returns lost money in 1970–1999, so trading those signals in reverse earned a modest, fairly broad return. I submitted it anyway, rather than keep searching, because tuning further against the validation verdict would just overfit it. Expect a real out-of-sample Sharpe well below 0.49. Every candidate I tried failed validation, so I have no evidence it will hold up after 2013.
